doc.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023

title: Robben Ford and Ardent Studios in Memphis
summary: She hosted the musicians in Memphis, with Robben Ford swinging by on his way to Italy; the history of Ardent Studios.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: There are a lot of great stories from that session by the way.
There’s a — jeez didn’t you have Robben Ford on — was it that record or I don’t know there’s some heavy duty guitar on that.

Yeah. That’s Robben Ford. We caught Robben. Robben is at the time, and he may still be, was semi-retired. And I know what that means in the music world, it just means you show him enough money and they’ve got time, and they love you like I hope Robben still does, they’ll come by, they’ll swing by. And that’s what he was doing. He was swinging by on his way to Memphis because he was on his way to Italy. He was spending time in Italy at the time. And I made it affordable for myself by putting myself in one of the low budget hotels and I took care of them, my guys, to make sure they had what they needed. I rented this big Lincoln, because that’s what you do in Memphis, right? I rented this beautiful car and I was their chauffeur, I went and picked them up from the hotel. We stopped at Starbucks and I got to know what their orders are, I order their favorite drinks. We scoot over to Ardent Studios where Isaac Hayes — all these wonderful people have recorded down through the years. Make sure they’ve got their snacks, barbeque, something for the vegans, something for the vegetarians. I took care of my fellas.

I want to work for you. You just gave me a flash. I did a bit of session work one time in Ardent Studios and the guy there goes — he points to a B3. And he said, “That’s the organ Booker T played “Green Onions” on. I said, “Whoa.”

Yeah. There’s some serious history in that place, just scary. Yeah. I spent most of my time just looking at the walls. They have wonderful pictures of the sessions that were going on in that place on the walls. So yeah. It was one of those things where, again, energy — you just walk around feeling the walls. Get me some of that. You know? Wow. What a place.
I hope you’re up on the wall as well.
Oh that would be sweet. Yeah.
